run_dpo_vlm_training: run DPO training on a vision-language model like Qwen2.5-VL with PEFT and LoRA
build_dpo_vlm_pipeline: build a DPO training pipeline for image-text-to-text models using HuggingFace TRL
test_dpo_vlm_streaming: test DPO VLM training with streaming dataset on Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct
run_dpo_vlm_quantized: run DPO fine-tuning on a vision-language model with 4-bit or 8-bit quantization
run_dpo_vlm_push_hub: run DPO VLM training and push the trained model to HuggingFace Hub
